name: 图形模块 · Graphic Modular

source_summary.provenance: Design interpretation from inspected local stills and/or the cited makers’ descriptions. Sources: https://futuredeluxe.com/work/heineken; https://futuredeluxe.com/work/vizio; https://futuredeluxe.com/work/google-pixel

visual_rules.medium_behavior: 具有图形设计秩序的风格化产品CG；简化表面频率和色彩角色，保留目标产品形态。
palette_logic: 少量有明确角色的色块形成对比；目标品牌色和输出要求优先。
visual_rules.shape_line_language: 清楚体块、间距、重复和节奏构成系统；轮廓可以图标化但关键产品结构维持可识别。
texture_material_logic: 大面积连续哑面或目标指定的单纯反射，与少量精细主件形成层级。
表面细节服从选定的风格化程度，不自动添加实拍颗粒或满铺微纹理。
visual_rules.lighting_logic: 简明而有方向的棚光、形状清楚的阴影或目标指定的风格化光；图形层级保持稳定。
composition_logic: 一个主件与有序辅助模块形成清楚阅读路径。
重复、切边和尺度对比服务于产品识别；文字只有目标明确要求时才参与构图。
visual_rules.optics_rendering_logic: 采用目标声明的正交或透视投影，保持投影和轮廓一致；节拍与模糊按风格选定。
motifs: 产品轮廓与辅助几何的呼应

inferred_traits: 用简明体块、节奏与形态呼应表达产品个性，适配清楚的短时识别。
These rules are a transferable design interpretation, not the source creators’ complete production method.
unknowns: Exact source lens, shader parameters, simulation settings and full frame-by-frame motion are not established by these rules.
Image transfer does not establish temporal stability or final video quality.
transfer_rules: Target identity, material, geometry, function, palette, layout, text and requested medium remain authoritative.
Select compatible visual mechanisms; do not import every motif into every target.
forbidden_transfer: Source product identity, exact packaging, protected marks, source wording and layout coordinates.
不复制来源字形、口号或标识；抽象模块不证明环保、显示性能或其他产品功效。

prompts: 制作一个原创、无品牌的产品CG纯画面。风格化CG，主件完整清楚，圆柱与方块沿同一弧线错落排列；影子形成有序节奏，表面连续而简明。 一副虚构无品牌珊瑚色头戴式耳机，深灰耳垫，作为主件与几个无字的圆柱和圆角方块组成图形式三维构图。
制作一个原创、无品牌的产品CG纯画面。风格化三维产品英雄画面，近似正交透视，曲柄和收粉仓读清，阶梯阴影与机身轮廓形成简洁图形节奏。 一台虚构无品牌小型手摇咖啡磨豆器，奶油黄圆柱机身、黑色曲柄与透明小收粉仓，旁边两个简洁无字阶梯模块。
validation.notes: Two different target scenarios were generated without source-image attachments and independently inspected. Static style transfer passed with recorded limitations. Actual PNGs are 1672x941; exact canvas, some framing/material-scale facts and moving-video behavior are not fully verified. This is not user adoption. See the validation record and separate evidence asset. Prompt entries are the target briefs; exact compiled native prompts and their SHA-256 are retained in the separate evidence asset.

evidence.review: Coral, pale blue and ivory volumes, repeated modules and directional shadows establish graphic rhythm. The full headphones remain readable; finer cushion detail is subordinate to the simplified modules.
A restrained palette, near-orthographic body, steps and shadows establish a modular system. The crank and clear grounds chamber are visible. Added coffee-bean props are a minor scene variation.
